class NoOpSpanExporter(SpanExporter):
    def export(self, spans: list[ReadableSpan]):
        return SpanExportResult.SUCCESS

    def shutdown(self):
        pass


def _capture_set_attrs(monkeypatch):
    captured = []

    def fake_set_attrs(span, attrs):
        # store a copy of attrs dict for inspection
        captured.append(dict(attrs))
        # optionally still set on span to keep behaviour similar
        for k, v in attrs.items():
            span.set_attribute(k, v)

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        "langfuse._client.span_processor._set_span_attributes_within_limit",
        fake_set_attrs,
    )
    return captured


def test_default_marks_app_root(monkeypatch):
    captured = _capture_set_attrs(monkeypatch)
    processor = LangfuseSpanProcessor(
        public_key="pk-test",
        secret_key="sk-test",
        base_url="http://localhost:3000",
        span_exporter=NoOpSpanExporter(),
    )
    provider = TracerProvider()
    provider.add_span_processor(SimpleSpanProcessor(processor))
    tracer = provider.get_tracer("test")
    with tracer.start_as_current_span("test-span"):

    provider.shutdown()
    # Look for a dict that contains the app‑root flag
    assert any(

    ), "App‑root attribute should be set by default"

    # No call should contain the app‑root flag when disabled

    ), "App‑root attribute should NOT be set when mark_app_root=False"
